rationale: The agent initiated actions on the user’s account (found user by email and fetched user details) and targeted plausible orders/items. However, it executed order-changing writes (returns, address change, item change) without any explicit user confirmation beforehand, violating the stated policy. Additionally, the user requested the tracking number of a cancelled order, but there is no evidence the agent provided any tracking information or identified which order was cancelled. The closing message contains no details of completed actions. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy and key information was missing.
